text: After researching which teeth whitening method was the best, I decided on Smile Seasons as their reviews were genuinely convincing. I popped in one afternoon and they agreed to see me the following evening as they were very busy. I was thoroughly briefed on the procedure, accepting that it might involve a little sensitivity during and after the session. They were very professional and after a scaling and three fifteen minutes applications of gel and Zoom treatment, I was honestly overwhelmed by the results. I've been a smoker for forty years, never had any whitening treatment and the dentist increased my shades by eight steps which left me with the third highest result possible. This is the treatment you need. Anywhere offering anything else will never achieve the results you will want.  Let this clinic help create a better smile. You won't regret it. Thank you to all the staff at Smile Seasons.
